name: Operational Release-Acquire/Relaxed RC11
description: An operational reformulation of RC11 supporting release-acquire and relaxed accesses (hence RAR), on top of which the authors build a proof calculus for invariant-based reasoning and mechanically verify mutual-exclusion algorithms.

catSupport.note: An operational reformulation of the RC11 release-acquire/relaxed fragment, proved to match it — and that fragment is what rc11.cat states.
